message.content:
Pea protein isolate is classified in HTSUS heading 3504 ("Peptones and their derivatives; other protein substances and their derivatives, not elsewhere specified or included; hide powder"). Subheading 3504.00.10 covers "Protein isolates," and 3504.00.50 covers "Other." The relevant CBP rulings on pea protein isolate, including those that consider origin and substantial transformation, classify it in 3504.00.10 or 3504.00.50. HTSUS 3504.00.10 is "Soy protein isolates" and 3504.00.50 is "Other," so pea protein isolate falls under the "Other" line.

The heading 2106 alternative is excluded because the product has no added substances. Heading 1108 and heading 2309 do not fit either.

The statistical suffix for 3504.00.50 is 3504.00.5000. Since the current schedule has 3504.00.10 for "Soy protein isolates" and 3504.00.50 for "Other," 3504.00.5000 is the right 10-digit code.
